lines.text: If you shout at Voyager 1 right now, it hears you tomorrow.
On November eighteenth, it reached one light-day from Earth.
That's about sixteen billion miles. Light itself needs a whole day to cross it.
It launched in nineteen seventy-seven, so the trip took forty-nine years.
Send it a command today, and it arrives tomorrow.
Then its reply needs another full day to get back.
Two whole days, just to say hello!
And it's the first human-made thing ever to get this far.
Its twin, Voyager 2, won't get there until twenty thirty-five.
Would you wait two days for a reply?
